faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Mohali (IISER Mohali) to fill multiple faculty positions across various departments for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The posts included in this recruitment notification are Assistant Professor positions across multiple specialized departments and academic areas within the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 vacancies available for Assistant Professor posts distributed among various departments like Earth & Environmental Sciences, Biological Sciences, Mathematical Sciences, and more.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for IISER Mohali Assistant Professor recruitment is 20 November 2026. Candidates must apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch along with at least three years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee details have been explicitly mentioned in the official notification released by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Mohali.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of applications by a screening committee, followed by a seminar presentation and a personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for Assistant Professors?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary package structured in accordance with the Central Educational Institutions norms established by the government.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can submit their applications online through the official recruitment portal provided on the official website of IISER Mohali.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official advertisement number associated with this recruitment notification issued by IISER Mohali is IISER M/ F/ (01)/Regular/2026.
